test_title: RRB Group D Official Paper (Held On: 10 Dec, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: 20 men can reap a field in 18 days. If the goal is to finish reaping the field in 30 days, after how many days should 9 men stop working?
solution:
**Given:**

20 men

18 days

30 days

9 men leave

**Formula Used:**

Total work = Men × Days

Work done in parts is additive

**Calculation:**

⇒ Total work = 20 × 18

⇒ Total work = 360 man-days

⇒ Let 9 men leave after x days

⇒ Work done by 20 men in x days = 20 × x

⇒ Remaining men = 20 − 9 = 11

⇒ Remaining days = 30 − x

⇒ Work done by 11 men = 11 × (30 − x)

⇒ 20x + 11(30 − x) = 360

⇒ 20x + 330 − 11x = 360

⇒ 9x = 30

⇒ x = 30 ÷ 9

⇒ x = 10 ÷ 3

**∴ The correct answer is 10 ÷ 3 days.**
